subject: Hosted API usage anchor + $/1M confirmation
body:
From: Emily Dunn <emily@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from demo — token volumes

Thanks, Hannah — good call today. A few answers and clarifications from our side: 

- Expected monthly tokens (production): we expect a steady-state of ~35M tokens/mo across our web and mobile clients.
- Peak TPS: traffic spikes during morning syncs and nightly batch enrichment. We expect a peak sustained TPS of ~85 TPS for short windows (~3–5 mins), and a burstable 140 TPS for 30–60s during campaign rollouts.
- Average prompt size is ~220 tokens; average completion ~120 tokens.
- Budget sensitivity: leadership wants to keep OPEX <= $2,600 / $1M tokens initially; we can stretch to $3,200 / $1M with stronger SLAs or committed burst capacity.

I attached the sample traffic export and a short note on our most common call patterns. Happy to review live if that helps.

—Emily
VP Product, ClearSight Health

Attachment: clearsight-traffic-sample.csv (CSV, ~12KB)

-----Original Message-----
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Dunn <emily@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from demo — token volumes

Thanks for the quick answers earlier today, Emily — outstanding detail. I captured the highlights below so we can align on pricing bands and next steps. Please confirm any of the numbers I got wrong.

Post-demo recap / items to validate:
1) Monthly tokens (prod): ~35M tokens/mo (steady-state) — please confirm if this includes test/dev traffic or just production.
2) Peak TPS: 85 TPS sustained, burst to 140 TPS for short windows — we will plan capacity to handle 100 TPS steady plus burst plan.
3) Token composition: prompt ~220 tokens / response ~120 tokens (avg behavior).
4) Target $/1M tokens: leadership target $2.6k — noted wiggle room up to $3.2k if SLAs or committed burst reserved capacity included.

Next steps (proposed):
- Redwood to produce two pricing sketches: a) pay-as-you-go hosted band with dynamic burst and b) committed monthly slab with reserved burst. Both to show nominal $/1M and effective $/1M after token discounts.
- We will include optional SLA add-on pricing for 99.9% latency SLOs and a reserved burst package for campaign windows.
- Emily to share anonymized traffic export (done) + callouts on retention/compliance needs.

Karthik and Marissa — looping you in for the sizing and sketch. ETA for sketches: Tue, Jun 16. Emily — can we schedule a 30-min review Wed morning (PDT)?

Thanks,
Hannah
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

-----On Tue, Jun 16, 2026 at 09:08 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference> wrote:-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Emily Dunn <emily@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API sketches — traffic assumptions attached

Thanks for the CSV, Emily — I ran a quick pass and sketched two cost profiles in the attached PDF (rdw-hosted-proposal-draft-v1.pdf). Key assumptions:
- Steady-state tokens: 35,000,000/mo
- Effective token split: 65% prompts, 35% completions
- Peak design target: 100 TPS steady with 140 TPS burst capacity for 60s windows
- Model family: small-ensemble open model (latency/budget optimized) — pricing assumes quantized variants for cost efficiency

A couple of clarifying Qs before we finalize numbers: 
1) Are enterprise audit logs retention requirements 90 days or 12 months? That affects storage and audit cost line items.
2) Do you need VPC/private deployment for HIPAA-sensitive PHI payloads or will hosted API with SOC2 + BAAs be sufficient?

I'll update the PDF with two price bands: (A) no-commit hosted unit price with burst credits, and (B) monthly committed slab with lower $/1M + reserved burst.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

-----On Thu, Jun 18, 2026 at 09:42 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference> wrote:-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Dunn <emily@clearsighthealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API usage anchor + $/1M confirmation

Emily — attaching the two finalized sketches. Quick summary to make exec messaging simple: 

- Option 1 (No commit): $3,450 / $1M tokens; supports bursts to 140 TPS via burst credits.
- Option 2 (12-mo commit, 30M/mo baseline): $2,150 / $1M tokens effective after commit discounts; includes 100 TPS reserved concurrency and a pay-as-you-go burst pool (up to 140 TPS) priced at incremental rate.

Notes: both sketches assume 35M tokens/mo steady-state, average prompt/completion split per Karthik. SLA add-on (99.9% latency SLO) is an additional $12k/mo. The proposal PDF includes a worked example showing monthly spend and token effective $/1M.

Can you confirm which option maps to your leadership $/1M target? If Option 2, we will draft an MSA + SOW and circulate redlines. If Option 1, we can enable immediate trial and configure burst credits.

Thanks — will hold a 30-min review slot Wed 08:30 PDT if that still works.

—Marissa
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: rdw-hosted-proposal-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, ~48KB)
